caption_segments: A modern building entrance features a door with a metallic frame, frosted glass panel, and silver handle, positioned adjacent to a glass wall as part of a secure access point.
The camera begins to pan right, moving away from the door while it remains visible in the frame, still showing its metallic frame and frosted glass panel.
Continuing the pan right, the subject is now fully out of frame and no longer visible, with only the surrounding structural elements in view.
The camera starts to pan left, returning toward the original area where the door was initially shown.
As the camera continues panning left, the same door comes back into clear view, displaying its metallic frame, frosted glass panel, and silver handle.

visibility_plan.seg2: still visible while camera starts moving away
visibility_plan.seg4: camera returns toward the original area
